Rafi decides it’s time to let others have a go. She realises that playground fun works best when everyone gets a turn.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: JoJo tries to grow a daffodil, but is disheartened to discover that it will take a long time to bloom. Cynthia tells JoJo how to take care of the plant, and Gran Gran shows JoJo a way to measure how much it is growing.

All the Clangers go indoors to give the Skymoos some peace. Granny realises something special is about to happen - the birth of a Baby Skymoo.

programme.title: BeddyByes

They take turns looking at the world around them.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: In a magical forest, colourful characters have adventures and are read stories. The Pontipines are playing a game of hide-and-seek with the Wottingers. The Pontipines hide whilst the Wottingers count. The Pontipine children keep changing their hiding places until they all end up in Upsy Daisy's bed! Only Upsy Daisy is allowed in Upsy Daisy's bed and here she comes!

programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Po have their favourite toys to play with, but Laa-Laa doesn't have the ball. The others help her find it. The Teletubbies watch a Tummy Tale about a boy and his favourite thing - a bike.

programme.desc: Tee is heartbroken when he can't find his favourite toy, Action Ape, and goes straight to Mo for help. Mo is more interested in helping Tee learn to look for things.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered how a library comes to exist? And how many ways can you cook a potato? Finally, will the Super Squirrels manage to stop an evil thief from destroying their toys?

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Duggee masters his ambition of building a model of the Clubhouse out of sticks, so the Squirrels start to think about what their ambitions might be. Norrie wants to learn how to break dance. Happy has always wanted to jump the famous triple puddle splash. Betty has always wanted to teach Mr Cuddles how to speak Portuguese. Roly has loads, from growing a potato to becoming a pirate. Tag spends a long time thinking what his could be, and then it clicks - he needs to climb over the log! Duggee gets to work helping all of the Squirrels train so they can reach their goals. Duggee teaches them that while it may be hard, the important thing is to keep trying and eventually you’ll get there. The Squirrels achieve their ambitions, and Tag successfully climbs over the log. Now they have achieved their first ambitions, the Squirrels can continue to reach for the stars. And they know Duggee is proud of them no matter what they achieve, and that they should be proud of themselves!

programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch's giant ball game threatens El Castillo. Can the Go Jetters bounce back and save it?

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When Squirrel Nutkin angers Old Brown by taking his glasses, it's up to Peter and his friends to put things right.

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: Animated deep sea adventure series. Captain Barnacles and his intrepid band of explorers roam the oceans in search of adventure and fun. Peso must perform an emergency fin bandage on a hungry great white shark, but first they need to subdue the giant predator using a trick called tonic immobility.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: The number friends take turns hiding behind each other in a song and dance all about bigger and smaller. Learn about comparing numbers with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: A simple skipping game turns into a night at the circus as I, G and H find themselves high up on a tightrope, with thrills and spills as they try to find the right way to get back down. This episode introduces the '-igh-' trigraph and the words tight, net, tent, high, light, night, right and fright.

programme.title: Nick Cope's Popcast
programme.desc: The old oak tree is being cut down. Can Nick and Norman save the tree and help all the animals that live in it? Together with today’s Popcasters, Natalie and Nina, they write a song for all the living things on the planet.

programme.title: Playtime Towers
programme.desc: It’s a hot day in Playtime Towers, so Bella helps Lift cool down with her flappy paper fan. This inspires Sketch to make flop-and-fold flutterby butterflies in Boxtropolis. In the Ice Disco, Hettie has a paper fan that’s perfect for the flap dance. Patch has a paper fan too, and it reminds him of the Wowee Peacocks' beautiful tail feathers, the perfect inspiration for his Fruity Fantails!

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Coco discovers Bing's dressing-up box so they both dress up. Coco is Princess Cococapono and Bing is, of course, King Bing. But there is only one crown and both need it to complete their outfits. When the crown gets broken, Flop helps them to make new crowns out of the broken pieces.

programme.title: Yakka Dee!
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say ‘squirrel’, and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see lots of different squirrels – grey, red and one with a very bushy tail. Some friends find scampering squirrels, we see a flying one and a supersquirrel wearing a cape! The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way, and everyone has a boogie when Dee’s friend finally succeeds in saying today’s word.

programme.title: Lu & the Bally Bunch
programme.desc: Biba struggles to wait for her turn on a new trampoline.

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: Kiri and Lou want to meet Dalvanius, who is very good at camouflage. He says he’ll only reveal himself if they promise not to laugh at his ears.

programme.title: Froglets
programme.desc: On a chilly day, the Froglets enjoy camping outside with a tent, jumpers and marshmallows.

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc: The Twirlywoos are in a bathroom where they watch a man running a bath, into which he puts some colourful bath salts. The Twirlywoos keep trying to reach the jar of bath salts but are interrupted by the man constantly coming and going with more things for his bath. In the end they reach the bath salts just as the Hooter calls them home. As they fly away, they knock the whole jar into the bath, and the man returns to find his bath overflowing with bubbles! The Stop-Go Car comes to visit the boat and brings the Twirlywoos a balloon. No sooner has he arrived than he is out the door again, and the Twirlywoos watch him drive back across the beach. He keeps coming and going, bringing more balloons each time, until Chickedy and Chick, who are holding all the balloons, start to float away! Only the combined weight of all the Twirlywoos brings them back down, and the balloons escape out of the door.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Maddie meets twin brothers Aahil and Abdul, and they become explorers. They use binoculars, hunt for dinosaurs and uncover fossils. Mr Tumble does his best impression of a dinosaur. There's fun with puppets in this spotty surprise. Featuring signs for the words binoculars, dinosaur and fossil.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: The voice trumpet leads a game of I Spy where the Teletubbies have to spot different colours - purple, green, yellow and red. What or who can they spot with those colours?

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: Nigel and Baby Bear welcome babies Ferne, Tobias, Betsy, Leo, Noah, Holly and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Inside everyone’s bags in this episode are Plastic Bottles which are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding safe, baby appropriate plastic bottles inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby! The fun nursery rhyme ‘Five Green Bottles’ features, as does a story involving Baby Bear. Plus, the Action Song gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with bubbles and the Goodbye Song.

programme.title: Tiny Tunes
programme.desc: In Tall Trees Forest, Lisa and the children play soldier skittles, learn signs for men, up and down, then sing and sign The Grand Old Duke of York.

programme.title: I Can Grow It

programme.title: Monster Makes
programme.desc: Murphi’s comic reading is disturbed by some fluffy fairy dust. Rebecca finds a muffin case, inspiring Murphi’s first make – a muffin case house. The Mini Monsters are making a tea set, and Rebecca’s great uncle needs to make some bunnies to support his acting career. Still unable to find the fluffy fairy, Murphi decides it is time for a mega monster make. The Recycling Express arrives with an old tea box, which is transformed into a box dragon, with a little assistance from the Tiny Helpers.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: It's so cold in the Valley that the Pea-Rexes risk becoming frozen!

programme.title: Vida the Vet

programme.title: Supertato

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: While playing baseball, Weasy hits a ball out of bounds. It lands on a scary scarecrow, which frightens the ducklings. Weasy makes fun of them, but he's scared, too! He leaves without the ball but refuses to admit that he’s afraid.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops

programme.title: Bluey

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Dad and his mates hit the backyard ready to rip up some tree stumps!

programme.title: Balamory
programme.desc: Miss Hoolie is planning a cycling holiday around Balamory, but her old bike needs serious TLC. Ava offers to fix it, until a few small repairs turn into a much bigger challenge.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Doug's tooth has fallen out, so Jess and Simon tell Waffle about the Tooth Fairy. Waffle longs to meet the Tooth Fairy and his dream comes true.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: At the playground, Khia won’t let Rafi and Ruby have a turn on the zip line. Rafi makes a wish for a magical new zip line that loops through the clouds and zooms around the park. At first, it’s amazing. But Rafi and Ruby ride again and again, forgetting the rule of one turn each. Soon, a long queue forms, and the friends realise they’re doing exactly what Khia did. Rafi decides it’s time to let others have a go. She realises that playground fun works best when everyone gets a turn.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Animation. Sarah and her best friend Duck embark on simple but exciting adventures, exploring the world both near and far in their own wobbly and imaginative way. Sarah and Duck try to play a tennis doubles match, but are two players short.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: The Skymoos have collected bits of metal from the Iron Chicken’s nest and are building a special nest of their own on the Clangers’ planet. The Clangers are intrigued - who can it be for? Tiny decides to decorate it with flowers from Mother’s garden, and Granny makes a special blanket for the nest. Soon a large group of Skymoos arrives. All the Clangers go indoors to give the Skymoos some peace. Granny realises something special is about to happen - the birth of a Baby Skymoo.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: BaBa looks for MeMo, who is hiding in the garden. At Play Time, they choose a cardboard tube to look through - a looky tube. BaBa sees GoGo Plane, the Tweeties and the Yummies. MeMo wants to look but doesn’t get a chance. At Yummy Time, they look for their food using the looky tube, and BaBa realises that MeMo wants to look too. They take turns looking at the world around them.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: In a magical forest, colourful characters have adventures and are read stories. The Pontipines are playing a game of hide-and-seek with the Wottingers. The Pontipines hide whilst the Wottingers count. The Pontipine children keep changing their hiding places until they all end up in Upsy Daisy's bed! Only Upsy Daisy is allowed in Upsy Daisy's bed and here she comes!

programme.title: Traffic Cops
programme.desc: Every year, police receive more than 200,000 tip offs on wanted suspects. And every day, Derbyshire's Traffic Cops rely on cutting-edge technology, special tactics and CCTV to make sure their wanted suspects don't stay wanted for long. In this episode, police hunt for a man wanted on suspicion of stalking. But what should be a routine operation quickly spirals into a tense standoff when emotions run high, and the officers must act fast to stop the situation going from bad to worse. And a tip-off leads officers to a remote woodland, where a wanted man is believed to be hiding in a tent. With the help of a police dog and a drone with a heat-sensor camera, officers close in on their fugitive. But with reports that the man could be violent, they need to be on their guard as they try to bring in their quarry. Series Prod/Dir: Simon Meehan; Exec Prod: Tayte Simpson; Mentorn Media (S14 Ep13)

programme.title: Traffic Cops
programme.desc: Every year, police receive more than 200,000 tip offs on wanted suspects. And every day, Derbyshire's Traffic Cops rely on cutting-edge technology, special tactics and CCTV to make sure their wanted suspects don't stay wanted for long. In this episode, police hunt for a man wanted on suspicion of stalking. But what should be a routine operation quickly spirals into a tense standoff when emotions run high, and the officers must act fast to stop the situation going from bad to worse. And a tip-off leads officers to a remote woodland, where a wanted man is believed to be hiding in a tent. With the help of a police dog and a drone with a heat-sensor camera, officers close in on their fugitive. But with reports that the man could be violent, they need to be on their guard as they try to bring in their quarry. Series Prod/Dir: Simon Meehan; Exec Prod: Tayte Simpson; Mentorn Media (S14 Ep13)

programme.title: The Neighbourhood
programme.desc: Graham Norton hosts The Neighbourhood, a brand-new high stakes, street-sized popularity contest. Set in the heart of The Peak District, six households from across the UK move into a 'picture-perfect' village to compete for a massive £250,000 prize. Things get heated when members of one household find themselves under increasing scrutiny, their game-playing comes under fire, and their social sincerity is questioned. As the sun rises over the close, one house is sitting pretty with immunity. Graham summons the neighbours to the village green for his next surprise in the form of a Fun Fair challenge, where one more immunity is up for grabs. Will it all be fun and games at the fair? True feelings about neighbours' game-play surface, leaving tensions high between two neighbours... The households head into their fourth removal, where they all have some big decisions to make. Will friendships endure?

programme.desc: The Walshes are halfway through their Australian road trip and they've reached the Gold Coast, where Barney has sun, sea and some serious action planned - starting with a trip to the beach, where they join a local outrigger canoe club for a race on the water. The next day, father and son meet some Olympic hopefuls and do their best to stay afloat as they learn the art of synchronised swimming. Their time in the Gold Coast ends with a visit to meet a stunt man who's worked alongside some of Hollywood's biggest stars, and he teaches the boys some stunts, but unfortunately for Brad he's going to be taking on one of the most dangerous ones - being set on fire!

programme.title: Bradley & Barney Walsh: Breaking Dad
programme.desc: The Walshes are halfway through their Australian road trip and they've reached the Gold Coast, where Barney has sun, sea and some serious action planned - starting with a trip to the beach, where they join a local outrigger canoe club for a race on the water. The pair then visit a wildlife hospital that was set up by the infamous animal-loving Steve Irwin and his family. The next day, father and son meet some Olympic hopefuls and do their best to stay afloat as they learn the art of synchronised swimming. Their time in the Gold Coast ends with a visit to meet a stunt man who's worked alongside some of Hollywood's biggest stars, and he teaches the boys some stunts, but unfortunately for Brad he's going to be taking on one of the most dangerous ones - being set on fire!

Set in the heart of The Peak District, six households from across the UK move into a 'picture-perfect' village to compete for a massive £250,000 prize. Things get heated when members of one household find themselves under increasing scrutiny, their game-playing comes under fire, and their social sincerity is questioned. As the sun rises over the close, one house is sitting pretty with immunity. Graham summons the neighbours to the village green for his next surprise in the form of a Fun Fair challenge, where one more immunity is up for grabs. Will it all be fun and games at the fair? True feelings about neighbours' game-play surface, leaving tensions high between two neighbours... The households head into their fourth removal, where they all have some big decisions to make. Will friendships endure?

programme.title: Bradley & Barney Walsh: Breaking Dad
programme.desc: The Walshes are halfway through their Australian road trip and they've reached the Gold Coast, where Barney has sun, sea and some serious action planned - starting with a trip to the beach, where they join a local outrigger canoe club for a race on the water. The pair then visit a wildlife hospital that was set up by the infamous animal-loving Steve Irwin and his family. The next day, father and son meet some Olympic hopefuls and do their best to stay afloat as they learn the art of synchronised swimming. Their time in the Gold Coast ends with a visit to meet a stunt man who's worked alongside some of Hollywood's biggest stars, and he teaches the boys some stunts, but unfortunately for Brad he's going to be taking on one of the most dangerous ones - being set on fire!

programme.title: Douglas Fairbanks Presents
programme.desc: Jason's House. 1956. Stars Finlay Currie, Patrick Holt & Charles Victor. A demolition crew tries to make a man leave his home of 50 years and he will not leave without putting up a strong fight.

programme.title: Command Performance

programme.title: Sleeping Car To Trieste

programme.title: Sergeant Cork

programme.title: The Edgar Wallace Mystery Theatre

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood

programme.title: Whispering Smith Hits London
programme.desc: 1952. Mystery. Director: Francis Searle. Stars Richard Carlson, Greta Gynt & Herbert Lom. US sleuth Whispering Smith arrives in London on holiday but soon becomes embroiled in a murder case. [S]

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: A captivating jukebox film from 1963 of the Kessler Sisters performing their song Quando Quando Quando!

programme.title: A Family At War
programme.desc: To Die for Spain. Created by John Finch. Stars Colin Douglas & Shelagh Fraser. To the family's dismay Philip returns to Spain to fight Franco's fascists, but will he ever come home? [S]

programme.title: Hannay
programme.desc: A Point of Honour. 1988. Stars Robert Powell, Christopher Scoular & Gavin Richards. An encounter with a young lady on a train leads to a strange weekend of mistaken identity and danger. [S]

programme.title: Z-Cars
programme.desc: Caught by the Ears. 1963. Stars Brian Blessed, Sidonie Bond, John Junkin & Archie Duncan. Watt must find proof that a farmer is collecting money from the government by altering cattle ear tags. [S]

programme.title: Public Eye
